description: CREHQ Modeled Site Pattern for a brand: empirical medians, ranges, percentiles, road-type mix, co-tenant mix, trade-area density, recent-opening context, and layer coverage/confidence. Use this to infer revealed-preference site patterns from where the brand actually operates. Do not present it as company-stated requirements unless the response includes stated-requirement provenance.

country.description: ISO country code filter (default 'US' where modeled context layers are available).

include_locations.description: Include representative location rows in the response (default false).
